title: Cylinder 5 Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit/Open
plain: The computer is watching the cylinder 5 deactivation/intake valve control circuit and sees what looks like a broken or disconnected circuit. Cylinder deactivation shuts off some cylinders while cruising to save fuel, and this circuit controls cylinder 5.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Fuel-saving cylinder shutoff may be disabled
Possible misfire, rough running or ticking noise

causes.name: Unplugged, loose or corroded connector at the cylinder 5 deactivation solenoid
Broken or chafed wire in the cylinder 5 deactivation/intake valve control circuit
Blown fuse or failed relay feeding the circuit

checks: Look over the connector and wiring for the cylinder 5 deactivation/intake valve control circuit, checking for damage, corrosion or a loose fit
Check power, ground and resistance of the part with a meter
Clear the code and see if it comes back
fix: Repair the wiring or connector if it is damaged; otherwise replace the cylinder 5 deactivation solenoid.

title: Cylinder 5 Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit Performance
plain: The cylinder 5 deactivation/intake valve control is not responding the way the computer expects. Cylinder deactivation shuts off some cylinders while cruising to save fuel, and this circuit controls cylinder 5.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Fuel-saving cylinder shutoff may be disabled
Possible misfire, rough running or ticking noise

causes.name: Low or dirty engine oil, or the wrong oil thickness
Sticking cylinder 5 deactivation solenoid or clogged oil screen

checks: Check the engine oil level and condition first
Check for misfire codes on the same cylinder
Command the solenoid with a scan tool and listen or watch for a response
fix: Correct the oil level and type first; if the code returns, replace the solenoid, and in some cases the lifter.

title: Cylinder 5 Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit Low
plain: The computer is watching the cylinder 5 deactivation/intake valve control circuit and is reading a voltage that is lower than it should be, which often means a short to ground or a failed part. Cylinder deactivation shuts off some cylinders while cruising to save fuel, and this circuit controls cylinder 5.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Fuel-saving cylinder shutoff may be disabled
Possible misfire, rough running or ticking noise

causes.name: Control wire to the cylinder 5 deactivation solenoid shorted to ground

checks: Inspect the wiring in the cylinder 5 deactivation/intake valve control circuit for rubbed-through insulation touching metal
Check the wiring for a short to ground with a meter
Clear the code and see if it returns right away
fix: Fix any shorted wiring first; if the wiring tests good, replace the cylinder 5 deactivation solenoid.

title: Cylinder 5 Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit High
plain: The computer is watching the cylinder 5 deactivation/intake valve control circuit and is reading a voltage that is higher than it should be, which often means a broken ground or a short to power. Cylinder deactivation shuts off some cylinders while cruising to save fuel, and this circuit controls cylinder 5.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Fuel-saving cylinder shutoff may be disabled
Possible misfire, rough running or ticking noise

causes.name: Control wire to the cylinder 5 deactivation solenoid shorted to voltage or the part open inside

checks: Inspect the wiring and ground connection for the cylinder 5 deactivation/intake valve control circuit
Check for wires melted or rubbed together in the harness
Measure the circuit with a meter before replacing parts
fix: Repair the open ground or shorted wire; if the wiring is fine, replace the cylinder 5 deactivation solenoid.
